newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps upgrades GTE South bonds.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps upgrades GTE South bonds.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Thursday it upgraded GTE South's first mortgage bonds and debentures to Double-A from Double-A-Minus, and reaffirmed the company's short-term debt at D-One-Plus.
About $735 million in public debt is affected.

Duff and Phelps said GTE South has solid bondholder protection measures and a lower overall level of business risk. It said GTE South has posted strong access line and minutes-of-use growth over the last several quarters and it expects the company to sustain its strong financial performance over the next several years.
GTE South is a wholly owned subsidiary of GTE Corp.
